items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: I did go to see Satchel Paige once

ctx.x: I don't keep up on all those sports.

Mm-hmm. Well, I'm going to tell you what, really true, I just began paying attention to sports since Jackie Robinson got in with them. Yes, that's right. I just didn't know anything about him before that time. And then being a nurse, I mean, I didn't have time to keep up with sports. I did go to see Satchel Paige once, the-
